# forgejo_user_avatar (Resource)

Manages the avatar for an existing Forgejo user.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Base64-encoded avatar image.
- `username` (String) Name of the user whose avatar is managed.

### Read-Only

- `hash` (String) Forgejo content identifier for the stored avatar.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier.
